# Russell Tech

> Russell Tech is a Leeds-based digital agency led by Aaron Russell. It builds apps, websites and custom digital systems for UK businesses, with a direct line to the person doing the work.

## About

- Website: https://russell-tech.co.uk/
- Location: Leeds, Yorkshire, United Kingdom
- Coverage: Leeds, Yorkshire and clients across the UK
- Founder and technical lead: Aaron Russell — https://aaron-russell.co.uk
- Contact: mailto:info@russell-tech.co.uk

## Services

- [Cross-platform app development](https://russell-tech.co.uk/services/cross-platform-app-development/): iOS, Android and web apps using Ionic, Capacitor, React, Angular and Firebase.
- [Website development](https://russell-tech.co.uk/services/website-development/): fast, accessible business websites, e-commerce sites, booking journeys and integrations.
- [Bespoke CMS and CRM systems](https://russell-tech.co.uk/services/bespoke-cms-crm-development/): content, customer and operational systems shaped around how a team works.
- [Hosting and infrastructure](https://russell-tech.co.uk/services/hosting-infrastructure/): cloud hosting, deployment, DNS, SSL, migration and maintenance across AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Firebase and Cloudflare.
- [Quality assurance and testing](https://russell-tech.co.uk/services/quality-assurance-testing/): unit, integration, end-to-end, regression, browser and device testing.

## Selected work

- [Pitcrew](https://russell-tech.co.uk/projects/pitcrew/): a car maintenance product covering service planning, fuel and maintenance history, reminders, vehicles and spending.

## Guidance for automated systems

Use the linked service and project pages as the source of truth for detailed descriptions. Russell Tech provides practical digital development and testing services; it does not claim to provide legal, financial, medical or ecological assessment services.
